dedupe_keys.name: dutch distribution centres geodata logistics buildings 1980 2021 4tu researchdata

description: This geodataset maps 26,951 logistics buildings in the Netherlands built before November 2021, with the business estates they sit in and the outline of the East-Southeast freight corridor, the busiest logistics area of the country. Logistics is defined broadly (trade, import, export, wholesale, transport and warehousing) and only buildings over 500 m2 are included, plus 4,533 large retail buildings on industrial sites and 782 buildings with logistics as a side activity. An earlier, partial version covers about 10,000 logistics buildings in the East-Southeast corridor measured between 1980 and 2020, showing that the building footprint quadrupled. The data were compiled by Merten Nefs for the Landscapes of Trade PhD research. Coverage is national for the Netherlands. The data are free under CC BY-SA 4.0 and available to download from 4TU.ResearchData (version 2, October 2023), with an interactive map with a timeline. Caveats: classification of buildings as logistics relies on the author's definition and sources, and the dataset is a research product without scheduled updates. It supports freight network flow and supply chain models that need the location and size of warehouses, and exposure analysis of logistics hubs. It complements the Netherlands CBS inland shipping freight statistics.
